notes.title: Christmas update!
notes.content:
Today we had an update in the game that many will like.

The dungeons at levels 25 and 30 will have triple EXP forever.

The dungeon at level 15 now gives different EXP for each level from 20 onwards, the higher your level, the more EXP (until level 24, at level 25 you can do the coal mines dungeon for better exp)

The cities of Nioreinas have been modified with a Christmas theme and Shaulalran will also be coming soon.

We will soon have the first castle siege, who will be the champion guild!

Invite your friends to play, now it's easier to reach higher levels!

Some balancing changes have been made to the classes: Lancer, Dragon Warrior, Viper and Ranger.
Information on our discord.

And we're still waiting for streamers to promote the game ♥

notes.title: A little update
notes.content:
The first update was small but necessary.

Some in-game items have been added that will soon be released for crafting.

Changes to the Draconic Warrior's abilities.
1 - Defense skill has been changed to Lava Stream.
Lava Stream traps the target for 2 seconds
2 - The Lava blade skill is now AOE from 1 cell away.
3 - The Circle of Fire skill is now dot, deals continuous damage for 3 seconds, and has also had its damage reduced to be identical to what it was before
4 - The old Lava stream skill that was received when doing the level 25 quest has now been changed to: Predator’s Pounce
Predator Pounce jumps at the target dealing massive damage.

QOL
Chat commands have been changed.
/l for local
/p for party
/g for guild
/w for world

Messages from players leaving the game and "skill on cooldown" spam have also been disabled.

That's it for the moment.

notes.title: The Wait is Over! "Tales of Fearless" Launches Today!
notes.content:
The time has come! 🎉

We are thrilled to announce that "Tales of Fearless" officially launches today in just 6 hours! After countless hours of development, passion, and the support of our amazing community, we are ready to welcome you to a world brimming with excitement and possibilities.

Tales of Fearless is a 2D MMORPG designed for players around the globe, offering immersive pixel-art visuals, thrilling battles, and a vast universe waiting to be explored. Whether you're a lone wolf or enjoy playing with friends, there’s something for everyone!

⏰ Mark Your Clocks: The countdown is almost over. Don’t miss your chance to be among the first to explore the game.

📥 Pro Tip: Add the game to your Steam wishlist and ensure everything is set for when the servers go live.

See you soon in the world of Tales of Fearless! 🌍✨
Team TOF

notes.title: Release date
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! I’m Naziozeno de Souza Braz, and I’m thrilled to announce the launch of Tales of Fearless, my 2D pixel art MMORPG, coming to Steam on December 6, 2024! This project is the result of years of hard work, passion, and dedication to creating a game that combines the charm of retro adventures with a unique and immersive experience for everyone.

From the very beginning, my goal has been to build a game that fosters exploration, adventure, and—most importantly—a sense of community. Every detail, from characters to landscapes, has been carefully crafted on the INTERSECT ENGINE to bring the world of Tales of Fearless to life with depth and wonder. Now, with a full English translation, players from all over the world can join us on this journey.

Why Tales of Fearless? This name represents more than just an adventure; it embodies the spirit of bravery, unity, and discovery that lies at the heart of this game. Tales of Fearless invites players to dive into a world filled with rich lore, unique quests, and the thrill of facing challenges alongside friends and allies.

Creating Tales of Fearless has been a journey of perseverance. From countless hours of designing pixel art to refining gameplay mechanics, every aspect of this game reflects my deep commitment to delivering an experience that players can connect with. I wanted to bring that classic feeling of MMORPGs back, where friendships are formed, alliances are forged, and each adventure feels meaningful.

As we prepare for launch, I’m excited and grateful for the support and enthusiasm from everyone who has been following the game’s development. My hope is that Tales of Fearless becomes a place where at least a hundred players join us on day one to celebrate this dream coming to life. Whether you’re looking to dive into epic quests, join guilds, or simply explore a new world, I invite you to be part of Tales of Fearless on December 6.

Thank you for being part of this journey, and I can’t wait to see you in the game!

Wishlist the game ;)
